selection: validation normalized 15-step cumulative-reward MSE; earlier candidate/update wins exact ties
posterior_subset: lowest-ID test episode, all four anchors and four action branches
limitations: Exploratory reuse of a previously examined test set, not confirmation
One frozen world-model seed; three readout initializations are not independent world models
New data are off-policy branches; full original training replay is unavailable, but a small contemporaneous learner minibatch is retained
Posterior resampling is a bounded one-episode diagnostic, not a global causal decomposition
Representation recoverability probes do not prove an irreducible information floor
No actor updates, new environment interactions, or online-performance claims
